title: Add a visual inventory-movement report field designer
description: On the existing inventory movement report page, choose visible ledger fields, preview the authorized page and download selected columns as CSV. Reuse the finite catalog and stock-query permission; preserve existing warehouse/product/date filters, base-unit and unknown-history semantics. CSV is current-page only with spreadsheet formula escaping. Fail closed on authorization and validation errors; existing HTTP operation audit records read-only requests. Development only: no migration, production SQL, real database execution, arbitrary model SQL, writes, secret/.env change or deployment. Verify Node UI logic tests and safe build/test; no real browser acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Inventory movement page opens finite field chooser alongside existing warehouse/product/date filters and sends selected fields to the authorized bounded preview.
Page safely renders selected columns and unknown-history evidence, preserves base-unit labels, and shows loading, empty, authorization, validation and network states without writes.

Current-page CSV follows selected field order, protects formula-leading text, and retains unknown values; Node UI tests cover selection, page limits, rendering, download and failures; document workflow.
